paper.abstract_en: We call a Riemannian metric on a four-manifold, as well as the underlying conformal structure, conformally even/odd if its self-dual and anti-self- dual Weyl tensors acting on bivectors have, at each point, equal/opposite spectra. The term mixed parity refers to the simultaneous occurrence of both of these conditions, an obvious example being the conformally flat case. After listing various known classes of conformally even metrics, we construct examples of conformally odd ones which are not of mixed parity, as well as some metrics of mixed parity that are not conformally flat. The former examples are provided by left-invariant metrics on Lie groups, and realize uncountably many local conformal-equivalence types. The latter also include some arising from Lie groups, as well as certain 1+3 Riemannian products that are not locally conformally homogeneous.
